_meta._comment: Source-of-truth English strings for Soul Link. Keys are dot-separated and grouped by surface. Add a key here first, then mirror it (with translation) into other locale files. Top-level keys starting with '_' are ignored at load time. Placeholders use {0}, {1} ordering.

hp_mode_desc.shared_pool: Shared HP pool across all players

gold_mode_desc.split: Gold earned is split evenly amongst players, but is spent individually

settings.additive_starting_hp_desc: Pool starts at [color=#{0}]sum[/color] of all players' starting HP instead of [color=#{0}]average[/color] (easier)

tip.title: ⊞ Soul Link
tip.centennial_puzzle: Also triggers when your teammate takes unblocked damage.
tip.self_forming_clay: Also triggers when your teammate takes unblocked damage.
tip.demon_tongue: Also heals when your teammate takes unblocked damage during your turn.
tip.lizard_tail: Also prevents your teammate from dying.
tip.emotion_chip: Also triggered by damage your teammate received last turn.
tip.spite: Also triggered by damage your teammate receives.
tip.tear_asunder: Also triggered by damage your teammate receives.
tip.fairy_in_a_bottle: Also saves your teammate from dying.
